claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring reduces Cold damage taken by 2d8 — a flat numeric subtraction from incoming damage of a specific type. This is mechanically distinct from grant_resistance (which halves damage). No atom in types.ts or v4 taxonomy covers a fixed-amount damage reduction. TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §13 explicitly records this as a known deferred gap.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you take Cold damage while wearing this ring, the ring reduces the damage you take by 2d8.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_environmental_immunity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The second effect protects against sub-zero temperatures — a world-level environmental hazard, not a combat damage type. No existing atom covers environmental condition immunity (distinct from grant_condition_immunity, which covers the 15 SRD combat conditions, and grant_damage_immunity, which covers the 13 combat damage types). This effect is DM-adjudicated in practice but is stated as a deterministic rule.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
